actual_scope: Prove exact right-vector cost equal to the column lower bound for every invertible target at every role count over a product of at most q local central F_q-algebras.
scope_change_reason: This is a scoped algebraic side result answering the common-pivot product question left by #4787, extending the two-role small-product theorem of ToikY #4334 and #4601. It is not a proof-assistant formalization, a supplier audit, or a complete physical caller.
bottleneck_link: The theorem identifies when a shared scalar chart preserves the exact formal recursive-interface factor count across different local components. Native coefficient preparation, frames, routing, restoration, precision, stock and a complete supplier invoice remain unknown.
stop_rule: Ship the first proved common-pivot extension with bounded corroboration. Do not extend to more components, singular targets or physical construction after this result.
evidence: PROOF.md proves the all-role theorem by finite-subspace avoidance, common scalar pivot flags and the cited active-column reduction. The standalone verifier checks all 28224 binary two-component three-role invertible targets, a separate 168-state normalized literal-alphabet BFS, 431 distinct bounded product examples, 7652 basis actions, 18200 scalar-subspace input checks, eight rejection controls and two boundary fixtures. The current selected baseline passes after materializing omitted sparse inputs. Advance claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19213541.
